subject.title: Feature Request: Add premium request % to /usage footer

question: Should the canonical per-response usage contract include cached active-provider quota windows, or should network-backed quota data remain an on-demand `/status` surface?
rationale: The feature is technically feasible, but it changes the data and latency boundary of ordinary replies; multiple credible unmerged implementations do not establish the intended permanent product behavior.

options.title: Keep Quotas In Status
options.body: Keep reply footers limited to prepared turn and session telemetry, with provider quota windows fetched only by `/status`.

options.title: Add Cached Quota Fields
options.body: Extend the canonical usage contract with generic cached quota windows while preserving plugin ownership and strict failure isolation.

recommendation.title: Keep Quotas In Status
recommendation.body: Keep reply footers limited to prepared turn and session telemetry, with provider quota windows fetched only by `/status`.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced usage footer modes, built the adjacent provider-usage architecture, and supplied the clearest prior issue-level direction.
